rules: A private loopback fixture address is replaced with public placeholder 127.0.0.1, including observations. This can affect comparison against private fixture hashes; original hashes remain evidence.

Checksum maps use explicit path/digest records rather than credential-shaped keys.
The comparison summary uses model_id instead of the ambiguous key metadata field; numeric results are unchanged.
The native integration input manifest uses explicit source path/digest records; cases are unchanged and the original manifest hash remains in its receipt.
